sourceMethods: All 128 active subnet profiles and 98 dated September 22–23 channel briefs screened.

187 public X account candidates sampled; 178 returned links; 188 deduplicated current post records collected. Selected original posts retrieved in full. Additional SN44, SN53 and SN112 sources followed directly.
Authenticated AlphaGap Feed and signed-in X/Grok checked alongside SubnetRadar, TAO Daily and TAO Media. Grok used only for lead discovery; primary sources govern publication.
168 repository paths scanned and refreshed; selected release notes and code changes inspected.
58 linked SubnetRadar Moments screened; new locks and lock-mode changes distinguished from sales.

SN112 full acquisition PDF read: definitive agreement September22, initial incentive mechanism planned Q4. SN44 latest Manako primary update reports15 stations. SN114/SN53 integration checked with both projects. SN15 current evaluation documentation reviewed. SN66 proof page available; checker not rerun.
Market and network-emission snapshot at 9:58 AM ET compared with September22: no zero/nonzero subnet-allocation transitions in the two snapshots.
YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked. Public SN78 UMI replay, members-only AlphaChaser replay and September23 ForeverMoney scheduled stream verified by video ID and watch-page metadata.
accessGaps: A broad source scan cannot guarantee every announcement is found. Private, deleted, unindexed and unsampled posts may be absent. Channel briefs are secondary AI-generated summaries and remain attributed/developing.
SN112 acquisition agreement is not proof of completed on-chain transfer; its initial mining mechanism is planned for Q4. The market roster still labels the slot for sale.
SN44 deployment totals, SN78 provisional scores and TAO.com volume are reported by their operators, not independently audited. SN78 Convo collaboration lacked separate counterparty confirmation.
SN66 proof and paper are accessible, but independent proof-checker execution, novelty and mathematical acceptance were not established.
SN78 public status still reports rewards inactive. SN122 CookingTAO’s planned Wednesday mainnet was not confirmed live at this cutoff; yesterday’s plan is not repeated as a launch.
Chain events are indexer-reported. A lock-mode change is not a sale. Repository merges do not prove operator adoption or active runtime deployment.
10 repository paths had access or refresh errors. Sources were checked at different times; repository refresh ended 9:58 AM ET.

editorialDecisions.decision: Exclude unrelated StonkFun pairs/platform totals, BlackRock tokenized-TAO speculation, generalized market hype and unsupported partnership claims. Preserve earlier editions.

Read full official PDF rather than relying on stronger X headline: signed definitive agreement, not completed chain transfer; Q4 incentive mechanism. Five-star editorial importance is not five-star certainty.
Use September23 primary15-station update; earlier12/target20/wider400 are not completed totals. Avoid conflicting hardware/site-visit details.
New problem1062(ii), not yesterday859. Proof artifacts accessible but not independently rerun.
Convo early collaboration; provisional scores not production ranking. Live status false on rewards_active and chain_submission_authorized.
No confirmed mainnet activation at cutoff; do not relaunch yesterday’s plan.
Primary config for spark-hermes: project10%, maintainer50%, one mergedPR; not universal requirement, not SN82.
No zero/nonzero allocation transition between snapshots; avoid filler emission story or unsupported manual-intervention claims.
